verdict.rationale: Devin's docs support running multiple Devins in parallel on independent tasks. The API and Devin MCP allow programmatic session creation, including on behalf of other users, plus scheduled recurring runs, and Devin handles codebase-wide work such as language migrations and framework upgrades. Together these let a user fan work out across many items, but only by orchestrating parallel sessions or scripting the API, not through a documented bulk-operation feature. Missing for 10: a first-party batch or bulk action (e.g., launching sessions across many tickets or repos in one operation), documentation of bulk management of sessions or results, and independent hands-on corroboration of large-scale parallel use.
